correctness.rationale: From Pieri and harmonic tensor decomposition, X^2, conjugate-X^2 and Xconjugate-X give multiplicity-one Dynkin lists A_j,B_j,T_j (0<=j<=p). Their intersections have the claimed rank-sensitive exceptions: N>=5 disjoint, N=4 A_p=B_p, N=3 X/Y collisions and a triple constituent precisely when 3|p. Orthogonal expansion of f^2 yields all phase terms. Magnitude balancing forces |a|=|b| and N>=4 c=0; the exact N=3 objective has derivative proportional to the stated strictly increasing cubic with one positive root. Triangle-equality congruences yield all phase classes, including the mod-3 collapse. Independently reconstructed Dynkin collisions N=3..8 p<=12 and symbolic derivative identities; read actual checker source; bounded examples are not proof of the universal claim.
